question: Consider a beam of light incident on a metal surface. According to the Wave Theory, how is the energy incident per unit area per unit time related to the parameters of the wave?

options.A: It is directly proportional to the frequency
options.B: It is directly proportional to the square of the amplitude of the electric field
options.C: It is inversely proportional to the wavelength
options.D: It is constant and independent of wave parameters
